rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PHILIPPINE COMMISSION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6847, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PHILIPPINE SPORTS COMMISSION ACT
rows.abstract:
Aims to meet the changing demands as sports and athletics become increasingly recognized and more people aspire to pursue their passion in sports.

Seeks to amend several provisions of R.A. 6847 to help amateur athletes through grassroots programs, to effectively expand the priorities of the PSC, to include not only elite athletes, but also emerging ones.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09099

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INCLUDE ETHNIC ORIGIN IN THE NATIONAL SURVEY CONDUCTED BY THE PHILIPPINE STATISTICS AUTHORITY
rows.abstract:
Intends to recognize and promote the rights of indigenous peoples (IPs) or indigenous
cultural communities (ICCs) within the framework of national unity and development.

Provides that the PSA, in coordination with the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) shall ensure the employment of enumerators, or the deployment of NCIP employees, who are knowledgeable of the different IPs and ICCs, and the language and appropriate 
manner of asking culturally-sensitive questions in gathering data on Ethnic Origin during the conduct of the national survey and national census.

Provides further that the PSA shall ensure that all surveys and documents issued by their
office should be culturally sensitive.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: PHILIPPINE CROWDSOURCING ACT OF 2018
rows.abstract:
Proposes to improve the process of charting policies that shall provide the country's desired direction through expanding the avenues of participation to the Filipino online community.

Intends to make good use of social media to give voice to the brilliant ideas and greatest concerns of the people through law-making, and make the Government to become much closer to the people it has sworn to serve so that democracy will flourish.

Refers \"CROWDSOURCING\" as a law that allows the public to participate in the legislative process wherever they are and it believes in the power of online crowdsourcing.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09212

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING RESOURCE CENTERS FOR INDIGENOUS CULTURAL COMMUNITIES/INDIGENOUS PEOPLES TO ENHANCE AND ENSURE DELIVERY OF ESSENTIAL SERVICES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to supplement the shortcomings of the IPRA law (R.A. No. 8371) because our IPs continually remain among the poor and marginalized sectors of our society; basic services remain deficient in geographically isolated and extreme areas (GIDAs); and reports of serious violations of their rights, their displacement from the ancestral lands, the environmental degradation, and cultural teardown still abound.

Provides that resource centers for IPs shall be ethnographically located, gender and rights based, and shall constitute service areas as Statistical Service Area, Human Development Index Service Area and Domains Management Service Area.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INDIGENOUS CULTURAL COMMUNITIES AND INDIGENOUS PEOPLES since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE SEVENTEENTH OF NOVEMBER OF EVERY YEAR AS NATIONAL STUDENT LEADER'S DAY
rows.abstract:
Proposes to instill in the youth the values of patriotism and responsible leadership and encourage their involvement in nation-building through the observance of an annual program of activities which shall be prepared and implemented, with the National Youth Commission (NYC) as the lead agency.

Aims to honor the efforts of student leaders of the past and to foster student leadership and academic excellence among the students of the present.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE DEPARTMENT OF CULTURE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to establish an independent Department of Culture which will promote and develop our cultural traditions and which will serve as legitimate government body that would coordinate all activities of promoting \"national identity and culture.\"

Aims to effectively preserve our Filipino heritage as well as promote the importance of
Philippine arts and culture.

Intends to abolish the National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA);  Intends to attach to the Department of Culture, the following agencies among others:  Cultural Center of the Phils.; National Museum; National Historical Commission; National Library; National Archives; Komisyon sa Wikang Filipino; Intramuros Administration, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT WAIVING GOVERNMENT FEES AND CHARGES ON THE ISSUANCE OF DOCUMENTS REQUIRED IN THE APPLICATION FOR EMPLOYMENT OF FIRST TIME JOBSEEKERS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to exempt first-time jobseekers from the fees required by government agencies on documents necessary for job application.

Intends to ease the burden that fresh graduates experience which involves securing and spending for the following:  Clearances (Police, NBI and Barangay); Certificates (Medical, Birth and/or Marriage); UMID; and other documentary requirements issued by the government that may be required by employers for first time jobseekers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE COMMISSION ON ELECTIONS TO PROVIDE FOR THE OFFICE SPACES OF ITS FIELD OFFICES, HEREBY REPEALING SECTION 55 OF BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 881, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Intends to repeal Sec.55 of BP 881 to address its conflicting provision which compromise the independence of COMELEC as guardians of the ballot by separating its field offices from the offices of the LGUs.

Proposes to delegate the responsibility of providing the needed office space for the office of the provincial election supervisor and his staff and the election registrar and his staff, to the COMELEC without the need for prior approval of the LGU concerned.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING SUSTAINABLE COASTAL TOURISM, PROVIDING MECHANISMS FOR ITS INSTITUTIONALIZATION, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to ensure the continued rise and longevity of our tourism industry through conservation, protection, and strengthening of our natural resources. 

Specifically addresses urgent issues on development planning and mitigation efforts on our coastal resources, creating therefore the National Coastal Recreational Area Quality Framework which will form and implement tourism development measures and practices which shall include among others, measurable and reasonable quality standards requirements such as ecological waste management; water quality and sanitation; protection of marine flora and fauna, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A UNIFIED SYSTEM OF EXTENDING AND PROCESSING SCHOLARSHIP GRANTS, STUDENT LOAN PROGRAMS, SUBSIDIES, BUSARIES AND OTHER FINANCIAL SUPPORT WINDOWS FOR THE FILIPINO YOUTH, ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL SCHOLARSHIP COMMISSION, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN \"ADOPT-A-LIBRARY\" PROGRAM, PROVIDING INCENTIVES THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to recognize the important role of the private sector in augmenting the government's efforts and resources in the construction and maintenance of libraries across the country.

Proposes to allow the private sector to assist a local government unit, public elementary or secondary school, or State University or College (SUC) in establishing and maintaining libraries within their respective jurisdiction.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2018-10-10

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OFFICE FOR SOCIAL WELFARE ATTACHEE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8042, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE MIGRANT WORKERS AND OVERSEAS FILIPINO ACT OF 1995, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Recognizes the significant role of social welfare attachÃ©s in the provision of appropriate social services to our overseas workers and their families, by institutionalizing their permanent posting and/or deployment to Philippine Foreign Posts. 

States that the DSWD shall deploy such attachÃ©s to manage cases of OFWs needing psychosocial services and Overseas Filipinos in distress such as victims of trafficking, illegal recruitment, sexually-abused, maltreated/mistreated Overseas Filipinos, abandoned/neglected children and vulnerable sectors.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08908

rows.author: H064;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE BLOOD DISEASE AND TRANSFUSION CENTER, DEFINING ITS OBJECTIVES, POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Intends to ensure that an adequate supply of safe blood and blood products, and their safe and rational use should be an integral part of the country's national health care policy and health care infrastructure.

Aims to establish a sustainable national blood system envision to offer comprehensive care for patients with blood disorders, including blood transfusion services.

Proposes that the Blood Center shall also become the primary provider of the state-of-the-art diagnosis, management and treatment of blood disorders and shall be provided the necessary tools and funding to conduct research on hematologic disorders and to serve as a referral laboratory for all hematologic diseases.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2018-10-10

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE ENERGY VIRTUAL ONE STOP SHOP FOR THE PURPOSE OF STREAMLINING THE PERMITTING PROCESS OF ENERGY PROJECTS
rows.title_short: Establishing The Energy Virtual One - Stop Shop For The Purpose Of Streamlining The Permitting Process Of Energy Projects
rows.abstract: Establishes an Energy Virtual One Stop Shop (eVOSS) under the supervision of the DOE which shall have the following powers and functions: a.) recognizes the legal effect, validity, and enforceability of electronic documents submitted in relation to applications for permits and/or certifications necessary for or related to applications for power generation, transmission or distribution projects; b.) utilizes an online payment system for all fees imposed for applications for permits and/or certification necessary for or related to applications for power generation, transmission or distribution projects; c.) provides a secure and accessible paperless processing system; d.) provides a secure and accessible system for all mother agencies, attached and/or subordinate agencies, LGUs, and other entities involved in the permitting process of power generation, transmission or distribution projects; e.) operated as 100% virtual storage and rules driven system build as an integrated shared service of the mother agency, attached and/or subordinate, LGUs, and other entities involved in the permitting process of power generation, transmission or distribution projects; and f.) utilizes a technology platform and operations management software platform for the mother agency,  attached and/or subordinate, LGUs, and other entities involved in the permitting process of power generation, transmission or distribution projects to build their define processes and forms within a strict timeframe using published standards.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11234 enacted on 2019-03-08

rows.author: I101;
rows.title_full: AN ACT EMPOWERING LOTTO WINNERS OF PRIZES AMOUNTING TO MORE THAN TEN THOUSAND PESOS TO DETERMINE HOW THE FINAL TAX ON HIS OR HER WINNINGS SHALL BE SPENT
rows.abstract:
Seeks to empower the Lotto winners the right to determine how to spend the final tax of twenty
percent (20%) specified in Republic Act No.10963, otherwise known as the TRAIN Law.

Provides that the taxpayer can specify in a notarized letter addressed to the President, a government entity, program or project to which the final tax shall be allocated and spent; otherwise if he does not choose a beneficiary or beneficiaries, the final tax proceeds shall form part of the incremental revenues and shall be spent as provided in the TRAIN Law.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GAMES AND AMUSEMENTS since 2018-10-10

rows.author: I073;H035;G095;I051;G084;G002;G064;D007;I042;H003;H070;H092;I097;I054;C045;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PREVENTING THE USE OF MOTORCYCLES IN THE COMMISSION OF CRIMES THROUGH BIGGER NUMBER PLATES AND IDENTIFICATION MARKS
rows.title_short: Preventing The Use Of Motorcycles In The Commission Of Crimes Through Bigger Number Plates And Identification Marks
rows.abstract:
Mandates the LTO to maintain a registry of motorcycles in a database to facilitate information retrieval to be used in official investigation and law enforcement purposes and to issue bigger number plates for motorcycles with alphanumeric characters which can be readable from at least twelve (12) meters distance which should be displayed at the back of the motorcycle for the purpose of ensuring the security and safety of citizenry from crimes committed with the use of motorcycles.

Penalizes motorcycle rider and passenger or passengers who used a motorcycle in the commission of a crime, whether grave or less grave felony under the Revised Penal Code, or as a means to escape from the scene of such crime, whether attempted, frustrated, or consummated.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11235 enacted on 2019-03-08

Includes amendments that will address the growing complexities of securities' transactions that will bolster the power of the SEC to effectively enforce its rules and regulations and render public service efficiently.

public service through the establishment of an Internal Affairs Service.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING REFORMS IN REAL PROPERTY VALUATION AND ASSESSMENT IN THE PHILIPPINES, REORGANIZING THE BUREAU OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT FINANCE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Instituting Reforms In Real Property Valuation And Assessment In The Philippines, Reorganizing The Bureau Of Local Government Finance
rows.abstract:
Seeks to improve real property valuation for the government by adopting a market based Schedule Market  Value (SMV) to be used as basis of local and national real property taxation. 

Reorganizes the Bureau of Local Government Finance (BLGF) under the Department of Finance, to provide the institutional support and accountability to operationalize the reform agenda, and oversee all matters relating to real property valuation in the country.

Requires all real properties, whether taxable or exempt, shall be valued or appraised based on the prevailing market values in the locality where the property is situated, in conformity with the valuation standards adopted pursuant to this Act.

Requires the BLGF to develop and maintain an up-to-date electronic database of the sale, exchange, lease, mortgage, donation and all other real property transactions and declarations in the country and on the cost of construction or renovation of buildings and other structures, and on prices of machinery.
rows.alias_name: “Real Property Valuation and Assessment Reform Act.”
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2018-11-12, transmitted to the Senate on 2018-11-13 and received by the Senate on 2018-11-13
